# Description

REPLACE WITH GILLNET DESCRIPTION: This form provides for the reporting
of estimates of retained catches in live weight equivalent (metric
tonnes; t) for the IOTC species, common sharks, and other bycatch
species. Reporting of quarterly estimates is voluntary and recommended
to assess seasonality of the retained catches. For each stratum, the
data coverage – i.e., the percentage (%) of amount of fish sampled –
derived from the coverage type must be reported to assess the
representativeness and quality of the estimates.

REPLACE WITH PROPER FORM LINK Click [here](./Form-1RC.xlsx) to download
a blank version of Form 1RC, or [return](./index.html) to the list of
all IOTC statistical data reporting forms.

# Data content

REPLACE WITH GILLNET DESCRIPTION: Total live weight of retained catches
by species, along with information on the value (%) and type of sampling
coverage used for the estimations by quarter if available, year, fleet,
fishery, retain reason and IOTC main area.
